title: sceptridium obliquum var. oneidense
intro: Sceptridium obliquum var. oneidense, commonly known as Oneida rattlesnake root, is a type of plant that belongs to the Liliaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Oneida rattlesnake root include pain relief, wound healing, and antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
